properties.query:
// Source:        Firewall / DNS inspection daemon (dns.inspection job)
// ASIM schema:   Dns
// Deploy alias:  vimDnsOpenSystemsDnsInspection
// Owner:         firewall team
// Aggregated by: ../../../shared/parsers/vimDnsOpenSystems.kql
//
// Per-source ("source-specific") ASIM parser for the firewall DNS-inspection stream.
// DNS inspection is a firewall feature, but it ships a payload unrelated to the fwlog
// connection log, so it is onboarded as its own product with its own strictly-typed
// parser (the same way ndr/zeek is a distinct product from ndr/ndr under one service
// family). The firewall NetworkSession parser is left untouched.
//
// Ingestion model (ADR-0002, native OTLP): logs land in the single OTelLogs table;
// the raw DNS-inspection record is the Body column, ingested as a string (parse with
// todynamic(Body) before access); the distributor tags the dns.inspection job with
// ResourceAttributes['osag.product.name'] == "dns_inspection".
//
// The firewall emits the DNS response code and query type as numbers; the IANA lookup
// tables below resolve them to names, mirroring the legacy parser documented in
// docs/deprecated/vimDnsOpenSystemsDnsInspection.md.
// Enum reference: https://www.iana.org/assignments/dns-parameters/dns-parameters.xhtml
let RCodeName = datatable(flags_rc: long, ResponseCodeName: string) [
    0, "NOERROR", 1, "FORMERR", 2, "SERVFAIL", 3, "NXDOMAIN", 4, "NOTIMP",
    5, "REFUSED", 6, "YXDOMAIN", 7, "YXRRSET", 8, "NXRRSET", 9, "NOTAUTH",
    10, "NOTZONE", 11, "DSOTYPENI", 16, "BADVERS", 17, "BADKEY", 18, "BADTIME",
    19, "BADMODE", 20, "BADNAME", 21, "BADALG", 22, "BADTRUNC", 23, "BADCOOKIE"
];
let RCodeResult = datatable(flags_rc: long, ResponseCodeResult: string) [
    0, "Success", 1, "Failure", 2, "Failure", 3, "Success", 4, "Failure",
    5, "Failure", 6, "Partial", 7, "Partial", 8, "Partial", 9, "Failure",
    10, "Failure", 11, "Failure", 16, "Failure", 17, "Failure", 18, "Failure",
    19, "Failure", 20, "Failure", 21, "Failure", 22, "Failure", 23, "Failure"
];
let RRTypeName = datatable(query_qtype: long, QueryTypeName: string) [
    0, "Reserved", 1, "A", 2, "NS", 3, "MD", 4, "MF", 5, "CNAME", 6, "SOA",
    7, "MB", 8, "MG", 9, "MR", 10, "NULL", 11, "WKS", 12, "PTR", 13, "HINFO",
    14, "MINFO", 15, "MX", 16, "TXT", 17, "RP", 18, "AFSDB", 19, "X25", 20, "ISDN",
    21, "RT", 22, "NSAP", 23, "NSAP-PTR", 24, "SIG", 25, "KEY", 26, "PX", 27, "GPOS",
    28, "AAAA", 29, "LOC", 30, "NXT", 31, "EID", 32, "NIMLOC", 33, "SRV", 34, "ATMA",
    35, "NAPTR", 36, "KX", 37, "CERT", 38, "A6", 39, "DNAME", 40, "SINK", 41, "OPT",
    42, "APL", 43, "DS", 44, "SSHFP", 45, "IPSECKEY", 46, "RRSIG", 47, "NSEC",
    48, "DNSKEY", 49, "DHCID", 50, "NSEC3", 51, "NSEC3PARAM", 52, "TLSA", 53, "SMIMEA",
    55, "HIP", 56, "NINFO", 57, "RKEY", 58, "TALINK", 59, "CDS", 60, "CDNSKEY",
    61, "OPENPGPKEY", 62, "CSYNC", 63, "ZONEMD", 64, "SVCB", 65, "HTTPS", 99, "SPF",
    100, "UINFO", 101, "UID", 102, "GID", 103, "UNSPEC", 104, "NID", 105, "L32",
    106, "L64", 107, "LP", 108, "EUI48", 109, "EUI64", 249, "TKEY", 250, "TSIG",
    251, "IXFR", 252, "AXFR", 253, "MAILB", 254, "MAILA", 255, "ANY", 256, "URI",
    257, "CAA", 258, "AVC", 259, "DOA", 260, "AMTRELAY", 32768, "TA", 32769, "DLV",
    65535, "Reserved"
];
let QueryClassLookup = datatable(query_class: long, QueryClassDisplayName: string) [
    1, "IN", 3, "CH", 4, "HS", 254, "NONE", 255, "ANY"
];
let parser = (
    starttime: datetime = datetime(null),
    endtime: datetime = datetime(null),
    disabled: bool = false
) {
    OTelLogs
    | where not(disabled)
    | where (isnull(starttime) or TimeGenerated >= starttime)
    | where (isnull(endtime) or TimeGenerated <= endtime)
    | where tostring(ResourceAttributes['osag.product.name']) == "dns_inspection"
    // Body is ingested as a JSON string; parse it before field access.
    | extend Body = todynamic(Body)
    // Payload event time (epoch milliseconds) and the numeric DNS enums.
    | extend
        PayloadTimestampMs = tolong(Body["timestamp_ms"]),
        EventSubType = iff(tobool(Body["flags"]["QR"]) == true, "response", "request"),
        flags_rc = tolong(Body["flags"]["RC"]),
        query_qtype = tolong(Body["query"]["t"]),
        query_class = tolong(Body["query"]["c"])
    | extend EventTime = iff(
        isnotnull(PayloadTimestampMs) and PayloadTimestampMs > 0,
        unixtime_milliseconds_todatetime(PayloadTimestampMs),
        TimeGenerated)
    // Resolve the numeric enums to their IANA names.
    | lookup kind=leftouter RCodeName on flags_rc
    | lookup kind=leftouter RCodeResult on flags_rc
    | lookup kind=leftouter RRTypeName on query_qtype
    | lookup kind=leftouter QueryClassLookup on query_class
    | extend
        ResponseCodeDisplayName = case(
            EventSubType != "response", "NA",
            isnotempty(ResponseCodeName), ResponseCodeName,
            flags_rc between (3841 .. 4095), "Reserved for Private Use",
            "Unassigned"),
        QueryTypeDisplayName = case(
            isnotempty(QueryTypeName), QueryTypeName,
            isnotnull(query_qtype), strcat("TYPE", tostring(query_qtype)),
            "Unassigned")
    | project
        TimeGenerated = EventTime,
        EventStartTime = EventTime,
        EventEndTime = EventTime,
        EventCount = int(1),
        EventType = "Query",
        EventSubType,
        EventResult = case(
            tobool(Body.block), "Failure",
            EventSubType != "response", "NA",
            isnotempty(ResponseCodeResult), ResponseCodeResult,
            "Success"),
        EventResultDetails = ResponseCodeDisplayName,
        EventVendor = "Open Systems",
        EventProduct = "DNS Inspection",
        EventSchema = "Dns",
        EventSchemaVersion = "0.1.7",
        Dvc = coalesce(tostring(Body["host"]), "DNS Inspection"),
        DvcHostname = tostring(Body["host"]),
        DvcAction = iff(tobool(Body["block"]) == true, "Blocked", "Allowed"),
        NetworkProtocol = toupper(tostring(Body["proto"])),
        SrcIpAddr = tostring(Body["q_ip"]),
        SrcPortNumber = toint(Body["q_port"]),
        DstIpAddr = tostring(Body["r_ip"]),
        DstPortNumber = toint(Body["r_port"]),
        DnsQuery = trim_end(@"\.", tostring(Body["query"]["n"])),
        DnsQueryType = toint(query_qtype),
        DnsQueryTypeName = QueryTypeDisplayName,
        DnsQueryClass = toint(query_class),
        DnsQueryClassName = coalesce(QueryClassDisplayName, "Unassigned"),
        DnsResponseCode = toint(flags_rc),
        DnsResponseCodeName = ResponseCodeDisplayName,
        DnsResponseName = iff(
            EventSubType == "response" and array_length(Body["answers"]) > 0,
            tostring(Body["answers"]),
            "NA"),
        TransactionIdHex = toupper(tohex(tolong(Body["txid"]), 4)),
        DnsFlagsAuthenticated = tobool(Body["flags"]["AD"]),
        DnsFlagsAuthoritative = tobool(Body["flags"]["AA"]),
        DnsFlagsCheckingDisabled = tobool(Body["flags"]["CD"]),
        DnsFlagsRecursionAvailable = tobool(Body["flags"]["RA"]),
        DnsFlagsRecursionDesired = tobool(Body["flags"]["RD"]),
        DnsFlagsTruncated = tobool(Body["flags"]["TC"]),
        DnsFlagsZ = tobool(Body["flags"]["Z"])
    // ASIM mandatory aliases required by ASimSchemaTester.
    | extend
        Type = EventType,
        Domain = DnsQuery,
        Src = SrcIpAddr,
        IpAddr = SrcIpAddr,
        Dst = DstIpAddr,
        DstHostname = DstIpAddr
};
parser(starttime, endtime, disabled)
